scene.language: This scenario represents a typical overlap in soccer, where there's a defender and a teammate, and to, to a- attract a pressure away from the teammate, a coach will run in an overlapped position and, and, and create an opening which can be used for a pass or the teammate can continue to dribble. (clicking)[0][1] Here, the coach makes the overlap and is now open. It -- if they can receive the pass from the teammate because the defender isn't too far. [2][3][4](clicking) Now, now that the coach has the ball and the defender is pretty far away, the coach can continue to run towards goal. [5]Okay.
